_comment: Soldier and Xbot are placeholders from the three.js examples (MIT); each plays its OWN clips, so no cross-rig retargeting is involved. peasant-man.glb is a real Mixamo character and is deliberately NOT referenced yet: its animations have not arrived, and borrowing Xbot's clips does not work because Xbot was re-exported through Blender and no longer shares Mixamo's rest pose. Point 'man' at it once idle/walk/slash/dying land in this folder.
